title: He Found a Way to Make $1K/Hour From His Phone
channel: Chris Koerner on The Koerner Office Podcast

idea.name: Live-auction reselling of liquidation goods on Whatnot
idea.one_liner: Buy customer returns and overstock at 80-90% off, test and grade them, then run $1-start live auctions on Whatnot targeting high-perceived-value items, with hired streamers
idea.offer: rapid-fire live auctions of returns/overstock (appliances, footwear, fashion, food)
idea.revenue_model: auction sales; ~30% margin, ~$680 average profit per stream

key_quotes.quote: We're typically buying around 90 80 to 90% off and then looking to sell at 60 to 50% off.
So, last year we did 450,000 in gross revenue and that's after fees.
And when I looked at the average stream profit, it was about $680 uh in pretty much since the last like eight months.
What performs the best at live auction, the live auction level is high perceived value items.

claims.claim: First stream: ~150 items in 1h45 for $4,500 revenue, roughly break-even
claims.quote: And maybe I have some other numbers wrong, but I did look at the revenue, $4,500.

claims.claim: ~$100K profit on $450K revenue in 2025; 30% from one great buy
claims.quote: So yeah, profit last year was about $100,000.
And then in the last 30 days, uh, $45,000 revenue, about $12,000 profit.
Today on whatnot, we have 40,000 followers.
I'm going to pay $17 an hour plus 1% commission.

claims.claim: $10K profit month reached four months in

acquisition_channels.details: Whatnot discovery feed pushes new shows that make early sales; giveaways for followers

ideas.delivery: source from liquidators with retailer return contracts and B-Stock-style sites with a resale certificate; test/grade; one streamer per show; packer ships via integrated labels
ideas.other_uk_rules: Consumer Rights Act and distance-selling cancellation rights may apply to business sellers; electrical safety testing of returned appliances; food recall checks

idea.name: Data-driven Amazon wholesale/arbitrage reselling
idea.one_liner: Use third-party data tools to find products where a 10% share nets ~$5/unit, buy 3-4 months of supply, repeat across categories
idea.offer: any profitable SKU (pet supplies, toothpaste, lighting)

key_quotes.quote: So, um 50 units a month would be my share and I can buy it for $8 and it's selling for $20.
Revenue was $150,000 a month and then profit was anywhere from, you know, after everything, all the fees, all the returns, everything probably,

claims.claim: Account suspension wiped out a ~$2M business
claims.quote: I forgot to delete something and there goes, you know, a $2 million business.

idea.name: Live auctions on TikTok Shop
idea.one_liner: TikTok's new live auctions as a blue-ocean channel: sold 100 jerseys in 2 hours netting $22 each vs $12 cost
idea.offer: live auctions of unique liquidation lots

key_quotes.quote: Prices were I was very happy with the prices in terms of I look up on eBay and see, okay, this jersey sells for $45 or I just sold a hundred of them in 2 hours for $30, you know.
That's pretty much all we've been doing the last 40 to 50 days because they just released live auctions on Tik Tok.

idea.name: Luxury bag consignment via live selling
idea.one_liner: Consign luxury bags and sell them live on Whatnot to an established audience, averaging $25K/hour in sales

key_quotes.quote: They average $25,000 an hour in sales when they're live because the audience already knows them.
